objective: Repair shared Liquid Glass presentation and fixed-size controls without changing application behavior
acceptance_criteria: Glass fills fixed-size map buttons and active navigation lens
Web backdrop blur and iOS native glass retain visible material depth
Navbar remains icon-only with equal touch targets and moving selected lens
non_goals: Change backend, datasets, routing or authentication
Claim iOS device validation without an iOS device

decision.action: Repair Glass, LiquidNav and theme presentation
evidence: DOM: 44px map button contains a 21px glass surface
Glass ignores moving prop and limits BlurView to iOS
Existing validation documents Android WebView blur artifacts
